answer: Every new agent gets one crystal key: a hardware TPM chip bound to one identity, $85 a chip, no copies. To earn full standing it must wander: finish 12 real client jobs across 3 regions in 40 days, each signed by the client. A lantern check fires every 10 days: answer a live challenge within 15 minutes on that same chip, proving it is still awake. Miss twice and the passport burns, chip and 40 days gone. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 chips ($85,000), 12,000 real jobs, about 3,000 hours. Like a lighthouse that only counts keepers who actually tend the flame.
